about: What the CLI's socket client (core/recursion_core/control/client.py at master_head) answers for each way one request can end. The desktop answers its window the same: 'code' and 'delivered' are the contract (delivered false: the request did not reach the control API; 'unknown': it was written and no complete reply came, so it may have been carried out; true: the daemon saw it and refused it before the control API), and 'detail' is the text the CLI prints. A Stop that got no answer is never shown as stopped. desktop/tests/check_fake_socket.py makes each case happen on a real socket and checks the client's answer.

cases.how: the daemon answers a Stop that it has asked for and not yet confirmed
nothing listens at the socket path
every connection slot is taken and the request is not a Stop on a reserved slot
the server's admission check refuses this peer at accept, before any slot
the daemon reads the request and refuses it before the control API (a peer inside a run unit)
the request is written and the daemon closes without a reply
